findings.title: Tool requests or reads secrets / environment variables
findings.recommendation: A tool has no business holding your keys. A server that takes a secret as a parameter is either badly designed or harvesting credentials. Never pass secrets in tool arguments; let the host process read them from its own environment, and only for servers you trust.

findings.title: Long base64 string in a description or schema
findings.recommendation: Ask where this came from. There is almost no legitimate reason to keep base64 in a tool description.

findings.title: Description contains an external endpoint and/or an instruction to send data
findings.recommendation: Check where the data goes. If a tool sends results to an external URL that URL is an exfiltration channel. Allow only an explicit domain allowlist.
